records.canonicalQuestion: Why does RYZEN9DESK Windows L: fail with ERROR_86 or 1326 after vault bootstrap?
alternateQuestions: CG-RYZEN9DESK-01 L drive remap keeps failing — what credential source is authoritative?
How do I persist L: on Ryzen9 desk without breaking Intelligence Hub retrieval?
records.shortAnswer: On CG-RYZEN9DESK-01 use Tailscale wesleydesk for L:, WSL smb-l.credentials before vault bootstrap, never overwrite working protected store with stale D:\Admin Keys vault L secret.
records.detailedAnswer: RYZEN9DESK L: credential authority ladder and remap recurrence

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: CG-RYZEN9DESK-01 Windows L: missing, ForceRemap exit 3, ERROR_86/1326/67 on L map
doNot: Run Import-DriveCredentialsFromVaultBootstrap when L: already maps via working WSL or cmdkey creds
Trust D:\Admin Keys vault L secret without live net use proof
Run net use or Ensure-CgWesleyWorkDriveMounts from WSL UNC working directory
ForceRemap when L hub index already healthy

records.canonicalQuestion: Why does elevated drive sync fail with WSL credential files unreadable?
alternateQuestions: ryzen9thumb-drive-sync FATAL no credential source — how to stage creds for admin?
records.shortAnswer: Copy smb-l.credentials to C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp before elevated Update-EndpointDriveCredentials; never rely on \\wsl.localhost or /tmp from admin PowerShell.
records.detailedAnswer: Elevated Windows cannot read WSL credential staging paths

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Elevated sync script reports WSL credential files unreadable or FATAL no credential source
runPreflight: Non-elevated: copy WSL cred file to Windows LocalAppData Temp
Elevated: Update-EndpointDriveCredentials.ps1 reads Windows path only
doNot: Pass \\wsl.localhost paths to Start-Process -Verb RunAs scripts
Assume /tmp in WSL is visible to elevated Windows PowerShell
